title: 陶瓷直接覆銅基板
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入DBC 陶瓷絕緣、銅層擴散及邊缘應力；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine dbc insulation, copper heat spreading and edge stress. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。資料表典型 k 和耐壓只適用所列測試條件；DBC、AMB 與薄膜金屬化不可視為同一製程。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Datasheet conductivity and breakdown values apply to stated conditions; DBC, AMB and thin-film metallization are distinct processes.

stages.title: 陶瓷與覆銅
stages.description: 本階段處理陶瓷與覆銅：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address ceramic and copper through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 辨識 DBC 結構

steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for identify dbc structure: Ceramic provides isolation; copper provides conduction and lateral heat spreading.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。畫銅陶瓷銅截面並標功能。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Draw a copper-ceramic-copper section and label functions. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：畫銅陶瓷銅截面並標功能。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Draw a copper-ceramic-copper section and label functions. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：所有陶瓷基板都使用同一覆銅機制。本步先檢查「辨識 DBC 結構」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到陶瓷提供電氣隔離，銅層提供導電與橫向熱擴散。所指出的物理限制。
